extracted.intended_audience: clinical trial investigators, protocol authors, trial methodologists, journal editors and peer reviewers assessing trial protocols
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and checklist for preparing complete, transparent protocols for randomized and other clinical trials (SPIRIT 2025), with multiple specialised extensions (e.g., PROs, AI, pathology, dose-finding). Intended to define standard protocol items to include across the whole protocol.

rubrics_metrics.name: Defining standard protocol items for clinical trials (SPIRIT 2025)
rubrics_metrics.description: Defining standard protocol items for clinical trials
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SPIRIT 2025 is an updated guideline that defines standard items to include in clinical trial protocols. The guideline is published simultaneously in multiple journals (BMJ 2025; JAMA 2025; Lancet 2025; Nat Med 2025; PLoS Med 2025) and has an accompanying explanation and elaboration paper (BMJ 2025).

rubrics_metrics.name: SPIRIT 2025 Checklist availability
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A downloadable checklist (SPIRIT 2025 Checklist) is available from the CONSORT‑SPIRIT website (https://www.consort-spirit.org/). Users should consult the checklist when preparing or reviewing trial protocols.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope: Protocol — whole report
rubrics_metrics.description: Applies to the whole report or to individual sections of the report? Protocol-whole report
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The SPIRIT 2025 guidance is intended to cover the entire trial protocol (not only select sections); protocol authors and reviewers should apply items across the complete protocol document.

rubrics_metrics.name: Study design applicability
rubrics_metrics.description: Study design: Clinical trials, Experimental studies, Study protocols
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SPIRIT 2025 is targeted primarily at clinical randomized trials and related experimental study protocols; authors of other trial-like or experimental protocols should consider applicability and consult relevant extensions.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPIRIT-PRO: inclusion of patient-reported outcomes in protocols
rubrics_metrics.description: SPIRIT-PRO: Guidelines for Inclusion of Patient-Reported Outcomes in Clinical Trial Protocols: The SPIRIT-PRO Extension.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This extension provides specific protocol items and guidance on how to plan, justify, and report patient-reported outcomes (PROs) within trial protocols. Citation: JAMA. 2018;319(5):483-494. (Link to abstract referenced.)

rubrics_metrics.name: SPIRIT-TCM: protocols for Traditional Chinese Medicine trials
rubrics_metrics.description: SPIRIT-TCM: Standard Protocol Items for Clinical Trials with Traditional Chinese Medicine 2018: Recommendations, Explanation and Elaboration (SPIRIT-TCM Extension 2018).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides TCM-specific protocol items and elaboration for trials involving traditional Chinese medicine. Citation: Chin J Integr Med. 2019;25(1):71-79.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPENT (SPIRIT extension) for n-of-1 trials
rubrics_metrics.description: SPENT 2019: SPIRIT extension and elaboration for n-of-1 trials: SPENT 2019 checklist.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extension and checklist specifying protocol items appropriate for n-of-1 trial designs. Citation: BMJ 2020; 368.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPIRIT-AI: protocols for interventions involving artificial intelligence
rubrics_metrics.description: SPIRIT-AI: Guidelines for clinical trial protocols for interventions involving artificial intelligence: the SPIRIT-AI Extension.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides AI-specific protocol items (e.g., model description, data handling, monitoring of algorithm changes) for trials of AI interventions. Citations: BMJ. 2020;370:m3210; Nat Med. 2020;26(9):1351–1363; Lancet Digital Health. 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPIRIT-Path: cellular and molecular pathology content
rubrics_metrics.description: SPIRIT-Path: Guidelines for cellular and molecular pathology content in clinical trial protocols: the SPIRIT-Path extension.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies protocol items to ensure adequate reporting of pathology-related methods and outcomes in trial protocols. Citation: Lancet Oncol. 2021;22(10):e435-e445.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPIRIT-Outcomes: reporting outcomes in trial protocols
rubrics_metrics.description: SPIRIT-Outcomes: Guidelines for Reporting Outcomes in Trial Protocols: The SPIRIT-Outcomes 2022 Extension.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives detailed guidance on defining, selecting, and reporting outcomes within protocols (outcome measurement, definitions, analysis plans). Citation: JAMA. 2022;328(23):2345-2356.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPIRIT-DEFINE: dose-finding trial protocol guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: SPIRIT-DEFINE: Enhancing quality and impact of early phase dose-finding clinical trial protocols (SPIRIT Dose-finding Extension).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides items and elaboration tailored to early-phase dose-finding trials (design, dose-escalation rules, safety monitoring). Citation: BMJ. 2023;383:e076386.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPIRIT Factorial: protocols for factorial randomized trials
rubrics_metrics.description: SPIRIT Factorial: Consensus Statement for Protocols of Factorial Randomized Trials: Extension of the SPIRIT 2013 Statement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies protocol items and considerations unique to factorial trial designs. Citation: JAMA Netw Open. 2023;6(12):e2346121.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPIRIT-Surrogate: reporting of surrogate endpoints in protocols
rubrics_metrics.description: SPIRIT-Surrogate: Reporting of surrogate endpoints in randomised controlled trial protocols (SPIRIT-Surrogate): extension checklist with explanation and elaboration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides items to ensure appropriate justification, definition, and planned analyses for surrogate endpoints in trial protocols. Citation: BMJ. 2024;386:e078525.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPIRIT-iNeurostim: protocols for implantable neurostimulation device trials
rubrics_metrics.description: SPIRIT-iNeurostim: Reporting guidelines for protocols of randomised controlled trials of implantable neurostimulation devices: the SPIRIT-iNeurostim extension.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies device-specific protocol items such as device description, implantation procedures, device-related safety monitoring and outcomes. Citation: EClinicalMedicine. 2024;78:102933.
